title: Twelve Years After the Snow Shovel: From Winnipeg to Beijing
titleZh: 铲雪十二年：从温尼伯到北京
description: Steven tries live-streaming on three platforms at once, and a 2013 Facebook memory leads him to retell how a dead-end warehouse job in Winnipeg pushed him to move to China. He also talks about Beijing's central heating, ways to raise students' IELTS speaking scores including the three types of fluency, student presentations, and his neighbor's revolving door of tenants.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目话题很杂。
sentences.en: Today's episode covers a real mix of topics.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文尝试在三个平台同时直播；一条2013年的Facebook回忆，把他带回了那个把他推向中国的冬天。
sentences.en: Steven tries livestreaming on three platforms at once; a Facebook memory from 2013 takes him back to the winter that pushed him toward China.

sentences.zh: 接着聊到北京的集中供暖、新电梯和雅思研究，最后是学生演讲，以及他那位神秘的邻居。
sentences.en: Then he talks about Beijing's central heating, the new elevator, and his IELTS research, and finally about student speeches and his mysterious neighbor.

sentences.zh: 直播初体验（也许吧）
sentences.en: First Livestream (Maybe)

sentences.zh: 史蒂文今天尝试把播客同时在三个平台直播。
sentences.en: Today Steven tried livestreaming the podcast on three platforms at the same time.

sentences.zh: 屏幕上到处都是他的脸，他觉得自己有点像黄仁勋，又自嘲说：“不不，完全不一样，财务状况差远了。”
sentences.en: His face was all over the screen, and he felt a bit like Jensen Huang, then joked about himself: "No, no, not the same at all, my finances are nowhere near his."

sentences.zh: 他2017年的英特尔MacBook Pro带不动直播，2024年的苹果芯片MacBook就顺畅多了。
sentences.en: His 2017 Intel MacBook Pro couldn't handle livestreaming, but the 2024 Apple-silicon MacBook ran much more smoothly.

sentences.zh: OBS Studio设置起来复杂得要命，他想先弄清楚自己到底喜不喜欢直播，再考虑买软件。
sentences.en: OBS Studio is incredibly complicated to set up, so he wants to figure out whether he actually likes livestreaming before thinking about buying software.

sentences.zh: 2013年的回忆：温尼伯铲雪
sentences.en: A memory from 2013: shoveling snow in Winnipeg

sentences.zh: Facebook给他推送了13年前的一张照片：他在家乡铲雪。
sentences.en: Facebook showed him a photo from 13 years ago: him shoveling snow in his hometown.

sentences.zh: 当时他刚结束在澳大利亚农场干活的一年半，又背包走了一圈东南亚，决定留在加拿大。
sentences.en: He had just finished a year and a half working on a farm in Australia, then gone backpacking around Southeast Asia, and decided to stay in Canada.

sentences.zh: 他通过劳务中介在仓库做临时工，自认是“仓库里学历最高、工资最低的人”。
sentences.en: He worked as a temp in a warehouse through a staffing agency, and saw himself as "the most educated, lowest-paid person in the warehouse."

sentences.zh: 工作约440小时后可以申请EI（失业保险），可中介在第十周后没有续约，他一直在交钱，却始终没资格领。
sentences.en: After about 440 hours of work you can apply for EI (Employment Insurance), but the agency didn't renew his contract after the tenth week, so although he kept paying in, he never qualified to claim it.

sentences.zh: 再加上激光近视手术的欠款，他下了决心：“不行，我不能这样下去，我该做更有意义的事。”
sentences.en: On top of that was the debt from his laser eye surgery, so he made up his mind: "No, I can't go on like this. I should do something more meaningful."

sentences.zh: 通往中国之路
sentences.en: The Road to China

sentences.zh: 2014年初，他给中东和亚洲的大学发邮件，并逐一排除：
sentences.en: In early 2014, he emailed universities in the Middle East and Asia and ruled them out one by one:

sentences.zh: 韩国： 已经住过。
sentences.en: South Korea: already lived there.

sentences.zh: 日本： 没有新鲜感。
sentences.en: Japan: nothing new.

sentences.zh: 新加坡： 薪水不错，可生活成本全给吃掉了。
sentences.en: Singapore: good pay, but the cost of living eats it all up.

sentences.zh: 中国： 没去过，那为什么不去？
sentences.en: China: never been there, so why not go?

sentences.zh: 北京一所学校回了信，要求他先考CELTA，费用约2400美元，随后是几个月的无犯罪记录证明、公证和各种文件。
sentences.en: A school in Beijing wrote back, asking him to first take the CELTA, which cost about 2,400 US dollars, followed by months of criminal record checks, notarizations and all kinds of paperwork.

sentences.zh: 哥哥出钱让他去参加表亲的婚礼，之后他借住在渥太华朋友家，8月在蒙特利尔上完CELTA，就飞去了中国，再也没有搬回家乡。
sentences.en: His older brother paid for him to attend a cousin's wedding; afterwards he stayed with a friend in Ottawa, finished the CELTA in Montreal in August, then flew to China and never moved back home again.

sentences.zh: 人们总说他一定特别爱这里。
sentences.en: People always say he must really love it here.

sentences.zh: 可中间还隔着新冠疫情，他每两三年就换一份工作，并非一帆风顺。
sentences.en: But in between there was the COVID pandemic, and he changed jobs every two or three years — it was far from smooth sailing.

sentences.zh: 播客存档与未完成的《Gemba》专辑
sentences.en: The podcast archive and the unfinished album Gemba

sentences.zh: 播客的存档分散在两个地方，所以他借助AI，正在为节目搭建一个网站数据库。
sentences.en: The podcast's archive is spread across two places, so he is using AI to build a website database for the show.

sentences.zh: 他后悔没有早点开始做视频博客。
sentences.en: He regrets not starting a video blog sooner.

sentences.zh: 2013年把他留在温尼伯的另一件事，是《Gemba》，一张受西非风格启发的打击乐专辑，用GarageBand录制。
sentences.en: Another thing that kept him in Winnipeg in 2013 was Gemba, a percussion album inspired by West African styles, recorded in GarageBand.

sentences.zh: 这张专辑至今还以三四个版本躺在他的硬盘里，没有完成。
sentences.en: To this day the album is still sitting on his hard drive in three or four versions, unfinished.

sentences.zh: 十二月鼓乐就要到了。
sentences.en: December drumming is just around the corner.

sentences.zh: 他笑着说：“哎呀，又添一件积压的活儿。”
sentences.en: He laughs and says, "Oh man, one more task added to the backlog."

sentences.zh: 集中供暖、新电梯和雅思研究
sentences.en: Central heating, a new elevator and IELTS research

sentences.zh: 北京又冷又多风，集中供暖在试运行后，终于在上周日正式开始。
sentences.en: Beijing is cold and windy, and after a trial run, the central heating finally officially started last Sunday.

sentences.zh: 今天早上冷得够呛，他都在重新考虑要不要骑车。
sentences.en: It was bitterly cold this morning, so much so that he's reconsidering whether to keep cycling.

sentences.zh: 楼里的新电梯已经能用了。
sentences.en: The new elevator in the building is now working.

sentences.zh: 工作上，他又花了一个小时研究如何帮学生提高雅思口语分数。
sentences.en: At work, he spent another hour researching how to help students raise their IELTS speaking scores.

sentences.zh: 难点在于把理论变成课堂实践，所以他自己做教材，这总比去年那堆现成的课件强。
sentences.en: The hard part is turning theory into classroom practice, so he makes his own materials, which is still better than last year's pile of ready-made slides.

sentences.zh: “你好，亲爱的教授”
sentences.en: "Hello, dear professor"

sentences.zh: 每周有六小时的必备答疑时间，史蒂文会把学生配成“雅思搭档”，互相问标准问题和追问。
sentences.en: Every week there are six hours of required Q&A time, and Steven pairs students up as "IELTS partners" to ask each other standard questions and follow-ups.

sentences.zh: 今天有位学生走进来说：“Hello, dear professor.”在美国，博士们会纠正他，说他只是“讲师”。
sentences.en: Today a student walked in and said, "Hello, dear professor." In the US, PhDs would correct him and say he's just a "lecturer."

sentences.zh: 所以他的说法是：“我是英语水平指导顾问，请记在你们的表格上。”
sentences.en: So his version is: "I'm an English proficiency guidance consultant, please put that on your forms."

sentences.zh: 这位学生还会模仿滑稽的英国贵族腔，史蒂文说，语言本来就是一种表演。
sentences.en: This student also imitates a comical posh British aristocratic accent; Steven says language is a performance by nature.

sentences.zh: 从5分到7分：流利度的三种面孔
sentences.en: From 5 to 7: The Three Faces of Fluency

sentences.zh: 一位学生问，语法怎样才能从5分提到7分。
sentences.en: A student asked how to raise their grammar score from 5 to 7.

sentences.zh: 靠死记硬背可以拿到6分，要到7分就得靠准确和细腻。
sentences.en: Rote memorization can get you a 6, but a 7 takes accuracy and nuance.

sentences.zh: 同样是“hello”，换五种说法就是五种态度，这也是雅思口语仍然由真人评分的原因。
sentences.en: The same "hello" said five different ways conveys five different attitudes, which is also why the IELTS speaking test is still scored by real people.

sentences.zh: 他了解到，流利度有三种：
sentences.en: He learned that there are three kinds of fluency:

sentences.zh: 认知流利度： 心里想得到，嘴上说不出。
sentences.en: Cognitive fluency: you know it in your head but can't say it.

sentences.zh: 表达流利度： 能说出来，但不一定准确。
sentences.en: Utterance fluency: you can say it, but not necessarily accurately.

sentences.zh: 感知流利度： 听者的判断，包括用词、话语标记和语块切分。
sentences.en: Perceived fluency: the listener's judgment, including word choice, discourse markers and chunking.

sentences.zh: 他的大部分学生卡在认知流利度上。
sentences.en: Most of his students get stuck at cognitive fluency.

sentences.zh: 他常拿女朋友的商务英语学位打趣她，其实很佩服她：一听到新的英文单词，就能立刻拼出来。
sentences.en: He often teases his girlfriend about her business English degree, but he actually really admires her: as soon as she hears a new English word, she can spell it right away.

sentences.zh: 学生演讲
sentences.en: Student Presentations

sentences.zh: 接下来一个月，每个班有两位同学做两到五分钟的演讲，题目不限。
sentences.en: For the next month, two students in each class will give a two-to-five-minute talk on any topic.

sentences.zh: 他最喜欢的一个讲的是：为什么可乐瓶是圆的，牛奶盒却是方的。
sentences.en: His favorite one was about why cola bottles are round, but milk cartons are square.

sentences.zh: 因为牛奶要放冰箱，方盒更省空间。
sentences.en: Because milk has to be kept in the fridge, and square cartons save more space.

sentences.zh: 邻居搬走了吗？多半没有
sentences.en: Has the neighbor moved out? Probably not

sentences.zh: 女朋友看到隔壁有装修工人，以为邻居要搬走。
sentences.en: His girlfriend saw renovation workers next door and thought the neighbor was moving out.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文表示怀疑。
sentences.en: Steven was skeptical.

sentences.zh: 新冠疫情以来，那套房子的租客走马灯似的换，每来一位新租客，就装修一次，可那位邻居还是照样出现。
sentences.en: Since the COVID pandemic, tenants in that apartment have come and gone in a constant stream, and every time a new tenant moves in, the place gets renovated, yet that neighbor still keeps showing up as usual.

sentences.zh: 他押的是：又一位租客，又一轮装修。
sentences.en: His bet: yet another tenant, yet another round of renovations.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 十二年前，一份没有前途的仓库工作把史蒂文推向了中国。
sentences.en: Twelve years ago, a dead-end warehouse job pushed Steven toward China.

sentences.zh: 如今他有暖和的公寓、好奇的学生和一部新电梯，而直播也表现不错，值得再试一次。
sentences.en: Today he has a warm apartment, curious students, and a new elevator, and the livestream went well too, so it's worth trying again.

vocab.en: revolving door; things changing in quick succession
to go through the motions, to be perfunctory
to stay temporarily at someone's place
